en.meta.title: T&LC License Upload Guide
en.page.title: How to upload your T&LC License
en.page.intro: Having trouble with the T&LC License step in the app? Follow the steps below — each numbered marker on the screenshots shows exactly what to tap or fill in.
en.step1.title: Go to the Document section
en.step1.body: In the registration app, open the Document section. You'll see a card labeled T&LC License.
en.step2.title: Tap T&LC License and fill in the details
en.step2.body: Tap the T&LC License card to open the form, then follow the numbered markers below in order.
en.step3.title: Find the details on your license
en.step3.body: Not sure where to look? Markers 3 and 4 below match the same numbers from the form in step 2.
en.step4.title: Save
en.step4.body: Once everything matches, tap Save (marker 5 in step 2). Your T&LC License step is now complete.
en.legend.tap: Tap this card to open the T&LC License form.
en.legend.upload: Tap here to upload a clear photo of your license.
en.legend.docnum: Type your license number exactly as printed on your card.
en.legend.expiry: Select the expiry date shown on your card.
en.legend.save: Tap Save once everything looks correct.
en.legend.cardnum: License number — type this into the Document Number field.
en.legend.cardexpiry: Expiry date — select this same date in the Expiry Date field.
en.tips.title: Before you save
en.tips.item1: Make sure the license photo is clear, well-lit, and not cropped.
en.tips.item2: Check that your license hasn't expired — you'll need to renew it first if it has.
en.tips.item3: The document number you type in must match the card exactly, including any letters.
en.footer.help: Still having trouble? Contact support from within the app for further assistance.
